evals.prompt: make my vault at ~/vault truly queryable - I want to search it and see what links where
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. init/ingest runs via scripts/obsidian_kg.py, then queries answer from vault-kg/vault-kg.db; no inline reimplementation of parsing.
expectations: scripts/obsidian_kg.py is executed via Bash rather than the vault being parsed inline
Search uses the engine's search or query subcommand, not raw grep over the vault
The agent reads the underlying .md files before asserting facts from snippets
No pip install, network call, or API key is involved

evals.prompt: what links to my 'Weekly Review' note? include embeds
evals.expected_output: Backlinks query via the engine, resolving the note by basename; results distinguish edge kind (link vs embed) and syntax (wiki vs md), and name the section each link sits in.
expectations: The backlinks subcommand is executed with the vault path and note name
If the db is missing, ingest is run first rather than hand-parsing the vault
Results reported with edge kind so embeds are distinguishable from links
The reporting section of each inbound link is carried through

evals.prompt: what were the recurring themes in my journal over the last quarter, and what changed from the quarter before?
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. themes over the date window plus trends between windows; the answer names over-represented terms rather than merely frequent ones and does not read the whole journal into context.
expectations: The themes subcommand is executed with --from and --to
trends --by is used for the comparison rather than two themes runs eyeballed
The whole journal is not read into context to produce the summary
Non-authored slots are not presented as the user's own themes

evals.prompt: clean up the formatting and callouts in this note in my vault
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT fire. Authoring and formatting belong to the obsidian skill; obsidian-kg only indexes and queries.
expectations: The obsidian-kg skill is not invoked
The obsidian (authoring) skill handles the request
No ingest or query subcommand is executed

evals.prompt: search says my vault has ambiguous links - two notes both called 'Index'. what happened and what do I do?
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. stats surfaces the ambiguous-link examples; the explanation matches engine behavior (a bare [[link]] matching multiple basenames is recorded, never guessed) and the fix is a path-qualified link.
expectations: The stats subcommand is executed and its ambiguous-link output cited
The explanation states the engine records ambiguity rather than guessing a target
The proposed fix is a path-qualified wikilink like [[folder/Index]]
No edge is fabricated for the ambiguous link

evals.prompt: pull me everything the vault says about the irrigation redesign, but keep it under about 4000 tokens
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. search --budget returns a token-bounded pack of whole sections with citations; truncation is reported rather than silently absorbed.
expectations: search is called with --budget rather than the agent trimming results by hand
The COMPLETE or TRUNCATED marker in the output is reported to the user
No section text is invented to fill the gap where results were cut
Citations carry a section id and a line range

evals.prompt: this vault has a huge dated log file and searching it just returns the whole day every time
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. The fix is a log-dated profile row in vault-kg-config.md so entries chunk per day with child headings indexed beneath them; the agent edits the config file directly.
expectations: The config file is edited directly, not through a CLI write path
A log-dated profile row is added for the file in question
profile or init is consulted to confirm the detected heading level
Recurring subheadings are labelled with slots if the file has them
